title: Armstrong Corset Lofts- 302-Downtown Arts District
description:
Parking is not included. 

This is a historic 3 floor building on the 5th Avenue of the Arts in downtown Nashville.  In the early 1900s it was the Armstrong Corset Shop.  Over the years I have renovated the 3rd floor & roof into 3 unique lofts.

The space
It's got double spiral stairs that we welded on site.  15-20' ceilings and exposed original brick.  Private rooftop deck in the middle of downtown Nashville.

Guest access
Unit 302 it's all your's.

Other things to note
Your loft has a private rooftop deck that only you have access to.  It has hanging tea lights for that summertime ambience.

If you like this style, please check out our lofts in our other building 3 blocks away, the 1882 Lofts.
